note: Special purpose districts are created in the Zoning Resolution to replace or modify the ordinary district rules for a defined area. A lot inside one follows the special district text first, and the underlying district only where the special text is silent.
how: Because a special purpose district writes its own rules, the ordinary Use Group tables on this page do not reliably describe what is allowed inside one. The controlling text is the Article of the Zoning Resolution that creates the district, and the boundaries and subzones are on ZoLa.

BPC.name: Special Battery Park City District
BPC.d: Battery Park City is governed by its own special purpose zoning designation rather than an ordinary R, C or M district.
BPC.note: What is permitted depends on which zone within the district a lot sits in, so the district code alone does not answer the question.

G.name: Special Gowanus Mixed Use District
G.d: Created by the 2021 Gowanus rezoning, the largest neighborhood rezoning in New York City in a decade, and the reason much of the canal corridor works differently from the districts around it. Brooklyn Community Board 6 voted to approve it.
zones: Most of the district is mapped as a paired M1 and R district, written as M1-4/R6A. The two run together on the same lot rather than one replacing the other.
The most common pairing in the district
The densest pairing in the district
G.note: A paired MX district is the answer to the thing this page says twice: that M districts bar housing as of right. The pairing is what removes that bar. On an M1-4/R6A lot, residential and light industrial uses are both permitted, which is exactly what the rezoning was for. It also carried roughly 200 million dollars in capital investment to NYCHA's Gowanus Houses and Wyckoff Gardens.

pairnote: Where a zoning district is written as two codes separated by a slash, such as M1-4/R6A, it is a paired MX district. Both sets of rules apply on the lot rather than one overriding the other, which is how an area can permit housing and light manufacturing at the same time.
